svg.title: Raho — app icon (full-bleed, canonical geometry per CLAUDE_CODE_FINAL.md)
svg.desc: IDENTICAL geometry to raho-mark-cream.svg per the LOCKED brand spec. Only difference: the background rect has NO rx (no baked-in rounded corners). Modern launchers (iOS, Samsung One UI, Pixel, etc.) apply their own corner mask on top — baking rx=44 caused a "double squircle" gap on Samsung where the launcher's mask was wider than ours, exposing transparent L-shapes at the corners. Dot positions, sizes, opacities, and the donut hole are EXACTLY as the canonical raho-mark.svg dictates. Do not modify.
